meaning.en: A strong supply of energy, enthusiasm, determination or motivation that helps somebody act with greater force or confidence.
meaning.zh: 一股強勁的精力、熱誠、決心或動力，使某人更有幹勁或更有信心地行動。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; friendly workplace conversation; sports and team situations; interviews; informal articles; personal stories; advertising or lively promotional language.

register.formalEn: It is usually unsuitable for highly formal academic, legal, medical or official writing. In such contexts, energy, motivation, drive or determination will normally be clearer.

benefits.en: The expression packages several related ideas into one memorable image.
benefits.zh: 教練的演說令他們充滿鬥志。 這個表達把活力、熱誠及決心等相關意思集中在一個容易記憶的畫面之中。

benefits.titleEn: It Expresses More Than Physical Energy
benefits.en: physical energy; enthusiasm; courage; determination; motivation; willingness to act.

benefits.titleEn: It Creates a Strong Visual Image
benefits.en: A tiger suggests power, movement and confidence. The image therefore makes the idea of renewed energy more vivid.
benefits.zh: 老虎令人聯想到力量、行動及信心，因此這個畫面能令「重拾活力」的意思更加生動。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful in Team Situations
benefits.en: feels tired; needs encouragement; hears good news; receives praise; prepares for a match; begins an important task.

benefits.titleEn: It Can Describe Both a Cause and a State
benefits.en: Students can therefore use the same core expression in several grammatical structures.
benefits.zh: 音樂令她充滿活力。 她充滿活力。 學生可以把同一個核心表達放入多種不同的句法結構。

benefits.en: The idiomatic version is more vivid, but it is not automatically more suitable in every context.
benefits.zh: 這個好消息令他精神大振。 慣用語版本更加生動，但並不代表它在每個語境中都一定更加合適。

origin.statusEn: Advertising Origin Well Documented; Exact First Coinage Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 廣告來源有充分記錄；確切首次創作仍未完全確定

history.en: The expression is closely connected with twentieth-century petrol advertising. ExxonMobil’s official history records that an advertising copywriter in Chicago produced the slogan in 1959. Historical newspaper research has also found a similar “tiger power” image in 1952 and exact or closely related versions used by petrol companies in 1959 and 1960. The safe conclusion is that the advertising origin is clear, although identifying one unquestionable first creator is more difficult.
history.zh: 這個表達與二十世紀的汽油廣告有密切關係。 ExxonMobil 的官方歷史記錄指出，一名芝加哥廣告文案撰稿人在1959年創作了相關口號。 歷史報章研究亦找到1952年的相似「老虎力量」意象， 以及石油公司在1959年及1960年使用的相同或相近版本。 因此，可以確定它源自廣告語言，但較難把唯一而確切的首次創作歸於某一個人。

history.en: The advertisement originally promised greater engine power. Speakers later applied the same image to people. A person with “a tiger in their tank” was imagined as having an inner supply of power, enthusiasm and determination.
history.zh: 這個廣告最初承諾為汽車引擎帶來更強動力。 後來，說話者把相同畫面應用於人物。 當一個人「油缸中有老虎」時，便象徵他內在充滿力量、熱誠及決心。

origin.memoryEn: Fuel powers a car; the imaginary tiger powers the person.
origin.memoryZh: 燃料為汽車提供動力；想像中的老虎則為人物注入幹勁。

rules.en: The article a is part of the target taught in this exercise.

rules.titleZh: 規則二：正確改變所有格
rules.en: The possessive refers to the person receiving or possessing the energy.
rules.zh: 所有格指獲得或擁有這股力量的人。

rules.zh: put 常見，但並非固定部分

規則五：保留時態及情態
rules.en: The incorrect answer changes a possibility into a completed fact.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案把可能性改成已完成的事實。

rules.en: The answer must not transfer the energy to another person.
rules.zh: 答案不可把活力轉移到另一個人物。

rules.titleEn: Use It Only for Noticeable Energy or Drive
rules.titleZh: 規則七：只用於明顯的活力或幹勁
rules.en: The improvement is too small to justify the expression.
rules.zh: 如果改變非常輕微，便不適合使用這個表達。

rules.titleZh: 規則八：不要按字面翻譯
rules.en: Incorrect answer translation: Natural answer translations:
rules.zh: 他的油缸裏有一隻老虎。 他充滿幹勁。 (他精神大振。 ) (他重拾活力。 )

rules.titleZh: 規則九：避免汽車油缸的字面語境
rules.en: The child put a toy tiger beside the car’s petrol tank. Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
rules.zh: 孩子把玩具老虎放在汽車油缸旁。 這個令人興奮的消息令他精神大振。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

examples.en: The exciting news put a tiger in his tank.
examples.zh: 這個令人興奮的消息令他精神大振。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse Related Tiger Expressions
rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要混淆其他 tiger 表達
rules.en: a tiger in your tank have a tiger by the tail These expressions are not interchangeable.
rules.zh: 充滿活力、熱誠或動力陷入一個難以安全退出的困難情況這些表達的意思不同，不能互相取代。

rules.titleZh: 規則十一：補充資料仍屬可選部分
rules.en: Time, cause and method phrases provide extra information. They are not fixed parts of the target.
rules.zh: 時間、原因及方式短語只提供補充資料，並不是目標表達的固定部分。

rules.titleZh: 規則十二：自然使用，不要過度使用
rules.en: 1. gains noticeable energy; 2. becomes strongly motivated; 3. recovers enthusiasm; 4. becomes ready for action; 5. shows unexpected drive. Ordinary words may be better when the context is formal or when the change is very small.
rules.zh: 當某人明顯恢復精力、動力、熱誠或行動意欲時，這個表達最為自然。 如果語境正式，或人物的改變十分輕微，使用普通字詞可能更加合適。
